test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pie-graph and answer the question that follows.

In a certain company, allocations to various sectors of the yearly budget per Rs. 7,200 crores are represented by this pie-diagram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d8268dc54fe8537400b63a63dbb5b2be264e8b50df05de02ba473c750e2b4ad.png] 

The expenditure (in Rs.) on Infrastructure is:
solution:
**Given:**

Total budget = Rs. 7,200 crores

Angle for Infrastructure = 84.7°

**Formula used:**

Expenditure on Infrastructure = (Angle for Infrastructure / 360°) × Total Budget

**Calculation:**

Expenditure on Infrastructure = (84.7° / 360°) × 7,200 crores

⇒ Expenditure on Infrastructure ≈ 1,694 crores

**∴ The expenditure on Infrastructure is Rs. 1,694 crores.**
